title: "I don't know what I don't know": Exploring the Benefits and Challenges of AI in Interdisciplinary Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.15121v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interdisciplinary research is widely lauded as beneficial for society but presents unique challenges to the researchers who bridge disciplinary boundaries. Despite the rapid increase in the availability and usage of AI systems for research tasks, there is little work studying how AI systems have impacted workflows that span unfamiliar disciplines. Through a survey ($N=62$) and follow-up interviews ($N=23$) with interdisciplinary researchers, we describe the unique challenges and opportunities for AI in interdisciplinary research workflows. Participants viewed AI both as a solution and exacerbation of the general challenge of "unknown unknowns": AI systems could facilitate a broad awareness of a new research area, yet also provide an illusion of understanding. Crucially, participants lacked the expertise and intuition to catch these illusions. Our findings motivate a focus on designing AI systems to support rather than automate collabor

translated_title: “我不知道我不知道什么”：探索人工智能在跨学科研究中的益处与挑战
translated_abstract: 跨学科研究被广泛认为对社会有益，但对于跨越学科边界的研究人员而言却带来了独特的挑战。尽管用于研究任务的人工智能系统的可用性和使用率迅速增长，但很少有研究探讨AI系统如何影响涉及不熟悉学科的工作流程。通过对跨学科研究人员的问卷调查（N=62）和后续访谈（N=23），我们描述了人工智能在跨学科研究工作流程中的独特挑战与机遇。参与者认为人工智能既是“未知的未知”这一普遍挑战的解决方案，也是其加剧因素：AI系统可以帮助人们对新研究领域形成广泛认知，但也可能造成理解的幻觉。关键在于，参与者缺乏识别这些幻觉所需的专业知识和直觉。我们的研究结果促使人们关注设计AI系统来支持而非自动化跨学科边界的协作式意义构建。
tldr: 研究发现，AI在跨学科研究中既能帮助研究者快速了解陌生领域，又会造成难以察觉的“理解的幻觉”，因此应设计支持而非取代研究者进行跨学科意义构建的AI系统。
en_tdlr: AI systems in interdisciplinary research can both broaden researchers' awareness of unfamiliar fields and create illusions of understanding that they lack the expertise to detect, motivating the design of AI that supports rather than automates collaborative sensemaking across disciplinary boundaries.
